title: PETC Submission Status
description: Response from GET /api/submissions/{id} and POST /api/submissions. The authenticated numbered lane owns the submission. The desktop short-polls for the LTMS result.

submissionId.description: Cloud UUID assigned at enqueue time

state.description: PENDING: queued with a lane quota reservation; IN_FLIGHT: being submitted to LTMS; BLOCKED: held for a non-quota operational block such as insufficient shared center wallet funds; ACCEPTED/REJECTED: terminal LTMS decision; DEAD: retry attempts exhausted. Only ACCEPTED consumes a daily lane quota slot; REJECTED and DEAD release its reservation.

laneId.description: Trusted cloud lane UUID derived from X-Center-Key

quota.description: Current Asia/Manila daily capacity for the authenticated lane, when included by the endpoint.

remaining.description: Slots remaining after accepted and reserved submissions

certificateNo.description: LTMS-issued CEC certificate key; present only when state=ACCEPTED

rejectionReason.description: Human-readable rejection reason; present only when state=REJECTED
